title: garcinia pervillei
intro: Garcinia pervillei, commonly known as the Perville Garcinia, is a plant species belonging to the family Clusiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include aiding in weight management and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Garcinia pervillei are attributed to its ability to modulate lipid metabolism and inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes. The bioactive constituents of Garcinia pervillei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and xanthones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
